# My Camino Financial

> Financial mentorship for women and non-binary people, founded by Leslie Roulias in 2025. You already have the capacity to make good decisions with your money. My Camino Financial gives you the clarity, confidence, and support to do it, on your terms. Serving the San Francisco Bay Area and clients across the United States, remotely.

Every engagement starts with a fifteen-minute intro call. Pricing is a sliding scale, stated as ranges.

## Pages

- [Home](https://makeitland.studio/for/leslie-roulias/): Who the mentorship is for and how it starts
- [About](https://makeitland.studio/for/leslie-roulias/about/): Leslie Roulias, her path from treasury desks at Fortune 500 companies to microfinance and mentorship
- [Packages](https://makeitland.studio/for/leslie-roulias/packages/): Five packages, each priced as a range. Thrive $800 to $1,400, Focus $400 to $700, Unite $400 to $700, Launch $400 to $600, Clarity $150 to $250
- [Mission](https://makeitland.studio/for/leslie-roulias/mission/): Clarity, Agency, and Support, and who the practice serves
